game.title: Dishonored 2
game.blurb: Stealth action game set in Karnaca, from Arkane Studios, released 2016-11-10. RAWG average playtime: 12 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Mission Secrets and Choices
chapters.summary: Saving the printer, the corpse for Mindy Blanchard, Addermire, Dr. Hypatia, Paolo, Jindosh and his lock, the Dust District sides, Stilton's key and other hidden moments.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Loot and the Heart
chapters.summary: Bonecharms, loot, black markets, paintings, Clockwork Soldier plates, Dreadful Wale souvenirs and journals, musical duos and the Heart's secrets.

chapters.title: Stealth, Powers and Combat
chapters.summary: Unseen and no-casualty missions, drop assassinations, Domino, Possession chains and trick kills.

chapters.title: Endings and Whole-Game Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing as Corvo or Emily, low and high chaos, unseen, no powers and no kills.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Dishonored_2
Fandom (dishonored.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://dishonored.fandom.com/wiki/Dishonored_2
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay, Enemies and Controls are linked but not written, and only a Table of Contents subpage (about 290 characters) exists. dishonored.fandom.com answers the API, with about 62 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Blacksparrow" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 403640. 9 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden; the first 8 in the schema have falling unlock rates (88 down to 35 percent), so they look like mission completions in order, and with "Years Ago, Another Time" they sit in the main story chapter. "Fearless Fall" (Addermire) was put in mission secrets rather than combat. Karnaca is named in "Songs of Serkonos".
